timing: Reviewed after core inference and before any HTTP inference in this benchmark.
rule: An ABSTAIN reference whose sole recorded reason is SOURCE_UNIT_UNRESOLVED predates the user-authorized default VND policy. Keep its frozen historical score, but exclude it from claims of correct rejection or wrong publication under the current policy. Do not invent replacement numerical gold.
limits: Withholding against a negative reference only verifies non-publication, not correctness of the explanation. Development reports and paraphrases do not establish generalization.
